description: Add a sticker to the workspace's "My stickers" pack. Send the text of an SVG (up to 200 KB, no scripts or outside links; it is drawn as a transparent PNG) or the media_id of a PNG already in the library. Answers with the sticker and its media_id.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

media_id.description: A PNG already in the media library

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: sticker_import
title: Add a sticker
